meta.title: Vietnam’s Most Dangerous Mountain Road, The Hai Van Pass
meta.description:
Week 21 in Da Nang. We'd had our motorbike for exactly two days when we decided to ride it up and over the Hai Van Pass. One of the most iconic mountain roads in Southeast Asia.

Friends visiting from the UK were driving up to Hue, we joined them for the ride over, stopped at a cafe on the way up, had seafood lunch at Lang Co beach, then turned around and rode home alone through the fog.

Got a little damp. Made it back before dark. 10/10 would do again. Genuinely one of the coolest days we've had in Vietnam.

If you're planning to do the Hai Van Pass — do it. Details below.
